paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of Kiddushin, chapter 1, halakhah 7: he came before Rabbi Ami and asked him to persuade his father to arrange a marriage for him.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Kiddushin 1:7 paragraph has Bar Terima come to Rabbi Immi and ask him to persuade his father to arrange a marriage for him. This supports the local full title and request direction; Hyman’s Ami spelling remains, with no new teacher or genealogy binding.
